workload.description: Evaluate bounded toWellFormed conversions over strings containing paired and unpaired surrogates.

validation.details: Host Node 18.19.1 lacks String.prototype.toWellFormed. The test now fails explicitly on that host; run the pinned patched d8 build to verify behavior and marker entry.

tests.coverage_note: This test exercises representative public JavaScript behavior, but V8 may use optimized builtins or fast paths instead of the marked native runtime fallback; region entry has not been observed in a patched build.
